abstract: We study whether and how the performance and factor exposures of the hedge fund (HF) industry as a whole and of 10 common HF strategies have been affected by unconventional monetary policy (UMP) announcements by the Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank. Using event studies, we find that UMP announcements are a highly significant risk exposure shifter for Dedicated Short Bias, Equity Market Neutral, Event Driven, and Multi-Strategy strategies as well as the aggregate HF index. We further show that the UMP affects HFs’ performance through significant changes in the betas of conventional HF risk factors. Our results for the aggregate and style indices are corroborated by an augmented Fama-French five-factor model, tests for breaks in US and Eurozone shadow rates, and analyses of more granular individual HF data.
title: Factor exposures of hedge fund strategies and unconventional monetary policy shocks
title_zh: 对冲基金策略因子暴露与非传统货币政策冲击

abstract: Farmers’ cooperatives play an important role in uniting smallholders to resist challenges and unexpected risks. The study aims to investigate the impact of farmers’ cooperatives on poverty alleviation in rural China. Research findings indicate that participation in farmers’ cooperatives contributes to poverty alleviation. Still, the impact remains positive for farmers located in non-major grain production areas or those engaged in non-family owned farms, whereas it is negative for those situated in major grain production areas or operating at family farms. The results were validated using various models and robustness checks. Notably, policy implications derived from farmers’ cooperative participation need to be tailored to account for variations among farmers. Furthermore, this study proposes several policy recommendations aimed at enhancing the positive impact of farmers’ cooperatives, including the promotion of education programmes on cooperatives, diversification of business activities, and the optimization of resource endowment for family farms, etc. Future research will investigate the mediating mechanisms through which farmers’ cooperatives influence poverty alleviation and will explore heterogeneity by education level and landholding size.

title: Joining farmers’ cooperatives leads to equitable poverty reduction in China – empirical evidence from the rural households survey
title_zh: 加入农民合作社促进中国公平减贫——来自农村家庭调查的实证证据

abstract: We study the effects of in utero exposure to a large cash transfer program on the health of children. Using data from South Africa, we use the age-eligibility threshold of the Older Person’s Grant and the variation in age differences between children and a coresident elderly to show that in utero exposure to the cash transfer led to a 0.26 SD increase in height-for-age of children. Among older children, we leverage the variation in the timing of the start of benefits to show important out-sized benefits of in utero exposure compared to starting later in early life. These results are robust to a variety of different checks including controlling for endogenous household formation. Given the importance of early child health in determining long-term outcomes, our results suggest that extending child-specific cash transfer programs to pregnant mothers can have long-term positive impacts.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了子宫内暴露于大规模现金转移项目对儿童健康的影响。利用南非的数据，我们依据老年人补助金的年龄资格门槛及儿童与同住老年人年龄差异的变化，证明子宫内暴露于现金转移使儿童身高别年龄指数提高了0.26个标准差。在年龄较大的儿童中，我们利用福利开始时间的差异，展示了与生命早期较晚阶段开始相比，子宫内暴露带来的显著超额益处。这些结果在多种检验下依然稳健，包括控制内生性家庭构成。鉴于早期儿童健康对长期结果的决定性作用，我们的研究结果表明，将针对儿童的现金转移项目扩展至孕妇，可产生长期的积极影响。
title: The Health Effects of In Utero Exposure To Cash Transfers
title_zh: 产前现金转移暴露的健康效应

abstract: Abstract Men’s historical advantage in educational attainment has recently been reversed in many countries. I study the implications for family formation of the new female advantage in education in the marriage market, exploiting a Finnish school reform that increased women’s relative level of education. I analyze the reduced-form relationship between marriage market exposure to the reform and family outcomes. I find decreases in marriage and fertility in marriage markets with a larger female educational advantage. These results are mostly driven by the mismatch between the educational distributions of men and women, and might have negative consequences for low-educated men’s mental health.
abstract_zh: 摘要 男性在教育程度上的历史优势近年来在许多国家已被逆转。本文利用芬兰一项提升女性相对教育水平的学校改革，研究了婚姻市场中女性教育新优势对家庭形成的影响。我分析了婚姻市场受改革影响程度与家庭结果之间的简化形式关系。研究发现，在女性教育优势较大的婚姻市场中，结婚率和生育率有所下降。这些结果主要由男女教育分布的不匹配所驱动，并可能对低教育水平男性的心理健康产生负面影响。
title: The Impact of the Female Advantage in Education on the Family
title_zh: 女性教育优势对家庭的影响

abstract: This article studies how cultural heritage influences the differences in risk taking in financial markets. We combine data on the asset allocation of second-generation immigrants in Sweden with risk-taking culture in their parents’ countries of origin. We find that descendants of risk loving cultures are more likely to participate in equity markets, and, conditional on participation, allocate a larger share of financial wealth to equities. Moreover, they take on more idiosyncratic risk by favoring directly held stocks over mutual funds and forming more volatile portfolios. These findings are not driven by selective migration or other country of origin characteristics.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨文化遗产如何影响金融市场中风险承担行为的差异。我们将瑞典第二代移民的资产配置数据与其父母原籍国的风险承担文化相结合。研究发现，来自风险偏好文化背景的后代更倾向于参与股票市场，并且在参与的前提下，会将更大比例的金融财富配置于股票。此外，他们通过偏好直接持股而非共同基金，并构建波动性更高的投资组合，承担了更多特质风险。这些发现并非由选择性移民或其他原籍国特征所驱动。
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Cultural Origins of Risk Taking in Financial Markets
title_zh: 金融市场风险承担的文化起源

abstract: Using administrative data from Texas, I track individuals from high school through college to the workforce to determine the effects of local labor markets on occupational choice. I find local labor market conditions are countercyclical with selection into teaching. Individuals sorting into teaching because of poor local labor market conditions are of higher ability (standardized tests) and have higher productivity (value-added). The findings suggest local labor market fluctuations shape career decisions well before individuals participate in the labor market, and increasing the relative economic standing of teaching as a career has the potential to improve the future supply of teachers.
abstract_zh: 利用德克萨斯州的行政数据，我追踪个体从高中到大学直至进入劳动力市场的全过程，以探究地方劳动力市场对职业选择的影响。研究发现，地方劳动力市场状况与选择从事教师职业呈逆周期关系。因地方劳动力市场不佳而选择进入教育行业的个体，其能力（以标准化测试衡量）和生产力（以增值衡量）均较高。这些发现表明，地方劳动力市场的波动早在个体进入劳动力市场之前就已塑造其职业决策，而提升教师职业的相对经济地位有望改善未来教师的供给。
title: Local Labor Markets and Selection into the Teaching Profession
title_zh: 地方劳动力市场与教师职业选择
